ideas.name: the book's last 60 sessions made money (in ATR units)
ideas.why: breakouts work in some regimes and not others, and regimes last months (as ADAPT found); trade it while it works

ideas.name: the book's last 20 trades won 60% or more
ideas.why: the same regime read faster: a breakout that has been paying lately

ideas.name: the book's last 5 trades made money
ideas.why: the shortest read of the regime: momentum in the strategy's own results

ideas.name: the previous trade today won
ideas.why: a winning breakout earlier says today trends; the next one rides the same flow

ideas.name: the day's P&L so far not negative
ideas.why: a day already losing is fighting the market; one at or above zero is in step with it

ideas.name: the same direction as the previous trade today
ideas.why: a second breakout the same way confirms the day's direction; a reversal break is a range day

ideas.name: 20 minutes or more since the last trade closed
ideas.why: a new break straight after an exit is the same move's noise; a fresh one is a new leg

ideas.name: longs in the last 60 sessions made more than shorts (with that side)
ideas.why: the regime's direction: whichever side of the breakout has paid lately is the market's lean
